shots.graphic: Grid draws itself; the lime square lands top left; «نصنع تجارب» slams up off the right margin with a lime ghost, slices into 3 bands, snaps back
Hero rises out, «تترك وسمة» rises in behind it; the square shrinks and lands as its full stop; it slices and snaps back on the beat
Poster shears out along the rows; the square opens into a lime viewfinder panel (cols 1-3); the five concept names swap through it on the beat; «خمسة عوالم صغيرة» on the right
Viewfinder closes to the square; 'Work that' slams up, 'leaves a mark' slides in letter by letter; the square is its full stop
Type shears out; the two ink strokes of the WASMA mark stamp down; the square arcs home into its slot; WASMA / وسمة rise in; hold
